title: rpic studio: a web editor and simulator for pic diagrams and SPICE circuits
description: rpic studio is a browser-based editor for the rpic language (Brian W. Kernighan's pic, reimplemented in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly): live preview with structured diagnostics, GSAP animations, the circuit-element library, geographic drawings on MapLibre maps, and SPICE circuit simulation in the browser through dune-sim (live sliders that write values back into the source, .measure panels, probes on element terminals). Everything renders client-side; sharing links carry the compressed source. Production instance: studio.rpic.dev. Engine: rpic.
